summary: Sound direction, but data lives on one device with no backup while the spec claims offline sync.

criteria.note: Reminder delivery when the OS kills the app is not covered.
No reverse migration for the local store.

findings.claim: The schema migration is one-way, so a bad release cannot be rolled back without data loss.
findings.fix: Add a reverse migration and a scenario that downgrades v2 to v1 with data intact.

findings.claim: Background reminder delivery after the OS terminates the app has no scenario.
findings.evidence: acceptance.feature has no scenario for a killed app
findings.fix: Add a scenario: reminder fires after the app was force-closed.
